title: AWQ 激活感知缩放：保护显著通道
code:
W = [0.31, -0.92, 1.47, -0.05]
act = [3.1, 0.4, 2.0, 0.1]
def awq_scale(w, act, alpha=0.5):
    sig = [a**alpha for a in act]
    s = sum(sig)
    scales = [x / s for x in sig]
    return [w[i]*scales[i] for i in range(len(w))], scales
sw, scales = awq_scale(W, act)
print("归一化缩放因子:", [round(x,3) for x in scales])
print("缩放后权重(显著通道权重被放大):", [round(x,3) for x in sw])
print("最显著通道索引:", act.index(max(act)))
